sn45.41:1.2: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū- -etad avocuṃ || || 3. Sace vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam puccheyyuṃ || ||
sn45.41:1.3: Kim atthi yam āvuso samaṇe Gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatī ti || evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam aññatitthiyānam paribbājakānam evam vyākareyyātha || ||
sn45.41:1.4: Rāgavirāgatthaṃ kho āvuso Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatī ti || || 4.
sn45.41:1.5: Sace pana vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evam puccheyyuṃ || ||
sn45.41:1.6: Atthi panāvuso atthi paṭipadā rāgavirāgāyā ti || evam puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesam añña- parib- evam vyākareyyātha || ||
sn45.41:1.7: Atthi kho avuso maggo atthi paṭipadā rāgavirāgāyāti || || 5.
sn45.41:1.8: Katamo ca bhikkhave maggo katamā ca paṭipadā rāgavirāgāya || ||
sn45.41:1.9: Ayam eva ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo || seyyathīdaṃ ||
